title: ModelRoute
description: A per-project named route alias (spec §27.6, E13 T8) that carries immutable, publishable revisions. Admin-only (the `provision` capability); never model-creatable. One lineage per project per name. EXACTLY ONE ALIAS IS LIVE: dispatch resolves the alias literally named `default`, and since E29 the create refuses any other name rather than storing a route that would be published and never consulted.

name.description: The alias a run resolves through. `default` is the only value a create accepts, because it is the only one dispatch reads.

consulted_by_dispatch.description: Whether a run ever resolves through this alias. False identifies a route created before the E29 name check — stored, publishable, and inert. It is rendered because refusing new dead names does not find the ones already stored, and a read-back is the only place an operator can learn a row steers nothing.

dispatch_note.description: Present ONLY on a route that dispatch does not consult, naming the alias that is live. Absent on the working route: a warning on every row is a warning an operator learns to ignore.
